userMessage: Create a generative page for the model-driven app that lets a maker bulk-add more Prize records into the andy_Prizes table faster. The page has a Prize Type choice/picker (from andy_PrizeTypes) and a quantity input, and creates that many new Prize rows, auto-filling the required Prize Name and Prize Info from the selected Prize Type.
agentMessage: Built a Bulk Add Prizes page: loads Prize Types into a Combobox (cached/de-duped against the host double-mount), a Quantity SpinButton (1-100), and a Create Prizes button that loops creating that many andy_prizes rows (auto-filled name/info, prizetaken=false, linked to the selected Prize Type). Shows inline validation, a success/error MessageBar, and a session table of created prizes.
